rows.section: Tariff rules (Schaffhausen)
rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single parents living with children or supported persons: the rate-determining income is the taxable income divided by 1.9 (Art. 38 Abs. 2 StG)

rows.section: Tariff rules (Schaffhausen)
rows.label: Basic tariff: taxable income above CHF 210,100
rows.note: n) Für Einkommen über Fr. 210'100.00 beträgt der Steuersatz einheitlich 9.9 Prozent.
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Schaffhausen (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, Art. 38 StG

rows.section: Tariff rules (Schaffhausen)
rows.label: Tax credit per child (Art. 192a StG)
rows.value: CHF 320 per minor child or child in education
rows.source_title: ESTV Kantonsblatt Schaffhausen (Stand: Februar 2026), Einkommenssteuer: Steuerberechnung, Art. 38 StG

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Schaffhausen; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Schaffhausen; other communes in Schaffhausen set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)
